Kubw’impamvu zitandukanye, hari ubwo haboneka imirambo yaba iyatoraguwe ku muhanda cyangwa mu mazi n’ahandi, ntihamenyekane ba nyirayo, n’imiryango ya ba nyakwigendera ntiboneke.

Hari nubwo umuntu arwarira kwa muganga, akanahapfira nta muryango afite. Ibyo byose bituma hari amatangazo akunze gutangwa n’ibitaro ko amatariki runaka, narenga nta muryango uraboneka, umurambo uzashyingurwa n’ibitaro cyangwa se ahandi bikavugwa ko uzashyingurwa na Leta. Ariko se bigenda bite? Ubwo se bikorwa na bande?

Mu Rwanda, biteganyijwe ko iyo habonetse umurambo utagira ba nyirawo (utazwi,cyangwa ari uwo mu muryango utabonetse), Leta ibinyujije mu buyobozi bw’inzego z’ibanze (Imirenge n'Uturere) bufatanyije n'inzego z'umutekano n'iz'ubuzima buba bufite inshingano zo kuwushyingura mu cyubahiro. Leta ifite inshingano n'ububasha bwo gushyingura umurambo wose udafite ba nyirawo (cyangwa uwo abavandimwe be badafite ubushobozi), hashingiwe ku Itegeko Nº 11/2013 ryo ku wa 11/03/2013 rigena imitunganyirize n’imikoreshereze y’amarimbi mu Rwanda.

Hari amategeko n'amabwiriza biteganya inshingano n’ububasha inzego z’ibanze , ziba zifite harimo kumenya no kwemeza urupfu. Iyo hatoraguwe umurambo udafite ba nyirawo (urugero: uwo mu muhanda, mu mazi, n'ahandi), inzego z'ibanze n'iz'umutekano (Polisi cyangwa RIB) zibanza kubimenyeshwa.

Ibijyanye no gushyingurwa na Leta, biteganyijwe ko iyo bimaze kwemezwa ko uwo muntu atazwi kandi nta muryango we uboneka, Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w'Umurenge uwo murambo wabonetsemo, afite inshingano n'ububasha bwo gutanga uruhushya rwo kuwushyingura mu irimbi rya Leta cyangwa irimbi rusange. Kwishyura ibikoresho n'imihango yo gushyingura bikorwa n'Akarere binyuze mu ngengo y'imari yagenewe imibereho myiza y'abaturage.

Mbere y'uko umurambo wose udafite ba nyirawo cyangwa uwabonetse ariko bikekwa ko nyirawo yapfuye, mu buryo butandukanye n'ubw'indwara isanzwe ushyingurwa, biteganyijwe ko hagomba gukorwa isuzuma rya muganga kugira ngo hamenyekane icyateye urupfu nk’uko bikubiye mu ngingo ya 29 y’Itegeko Nº 11/2013 ryo ku wa 11/03/2013 rigena imitunganyirize n’imikoreshereze y’amarimbi mu Rwanda.

Ubusabe bwo gukora isuzuma butangwa n'Urukiko rw'Ibanze cyangwa Umugenzacyaha (Judicial Police Officer/RIB) ukorera mu gace uwo murambo wabonetsemo. Uko bigenda, Ibitaro n'Inzego z'Umutekano, birakorana ku buryo, mbere y'uko umurambo nk’uwo ushyingurwa, ubanza kujyanwa mu buruhukiro bw'ibitaro (mortuary) kugira ngo ukorerwe isuzuma (autopsy) n'Urwego rw'Ubugenzacyaha (RIB) cyangwa Rwanda Forensic Institute (RFI). Iyo amatariki ateganyijwe ashize nta muryango uje kuwubaza, ibitaro bifatanyije n'Akarere bikoresha abakozi babyo cyangwa ab'irimbi rya Leta bakawushyingura.

Ibyerekeye ahantu n'uburyo bwo gushyingura, itegeko riteganya ko imirambo nk'iyo ishyingurwa mu bice by'amarimbi ya Leta byagenewe abantu batishoboye cyangwa abadafite ababo. Iyo byemejwe ko ushyingurwa mu buryo bwo gutwikwa(Cremation), Iryo tegeko rigenga iby’amarimbi ryo mu 2013, rivuga ko iyo ari umurambo udafite ba nyirawo, Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w'Umurenge abyemeza hashingiwe ku cyemezo cya muganga. Umuryango cyangwa abandi bantu bashobora kuzaza gushaka uwo muntu nyuma, bahabwa ivu rye ryabitswe mu buryo bwemewe n'amategeko.

Hari kandi ibyerekeye kubika neza amakuru n'imyirondoro by’umurambo ugiye gushyingurwa na Leta kuko udafite ba nyirawo, aho urwego rw'Umutekano rwandika amakuru yose ashoboka ku muntu wabonetse (ifoto, imyambaro yari ayoboye, n'ibimenyetso by'uwo ari we) mu rwego rwo gufasha abantu bashobora kuzaboneka nyuma bafite aho bahuriye na nyakwigendera.

Ku byerekeye aho Leta ikura abantu bo gushyingura iyo mirambo, bikorwa binyuze mu buryo bwo gukoresha amakoperative cyangwa ibigo bishinzwe isuku mu marimba. Uturere n'Imirenge bikunze kugirana amasezerano n'amakoperative cyangwa ibigo by'abikorera bishinzwe gucunga amarimbi rusange cyangwa gukora isuku mu mijyi. Iyo hari umurambo nk'uwo ugomba gushyingurwa, abo bakozi b'ibyo bigo ni bo babikora bakishyurwa na Leta.

Mu gushyingura imirambo nk’iyo yabonetse ariko nta ba nyirayo babonetse, inzego z'ibanze zishobora guhemba abakozi bazo basanzwe bafasha mu mirimo y'Akarere itandukanye cyangwa abasanzwe bacukura imva mu marimbi rusange.

Muri macye, Leta ntabwo ijya gushaka abantu mu muhanda,babonetse bose, kugira ngo babe ari bo bashyingura imirambo nk’iyo, ahubwo ikoresha abakozi b’amakoperative cyangwa ibigo byasinyanye amasezerano n'inzego z'ibanze mu gucunga amarimbi n'isuku, kandi bose bakishyurwa n'ingengo y'imari y'Akarere cyangwa iy'Ibitaro bya Leta.

Dr Sebajuri Jean Marie Vianney, Umuyobozi mukuru w’Ibitaro by’Akarere ka Bugesera(ADEPR-Nyamata), yasobonuye uko bigenda mu gihe, hari umurambo uri mu buruhukiro bw’ibyo bitaro ayobora kandi bikagaragara ko nta banyirawo bahari.

Yagize ati, “ Iyo umuntu ari muri ‘morgue’ yacu,bikaba bigaragara ko adafite umuntu uza kumufata,usanga ibyo bibazo tubigira (social cases) kandi biba bihari. Ibitaro dutanga itangazo,iryo tangazo ryamara gutangwa tugategereza iminsi itatu(3), muri iyo minsi 3, iyo hatabonetse umuntu uza kumufata ngo ajye kumushyingura,ibitaro biramushyingura.Nta ngengo y’imari yihariye tugira igenewe ibyo, ariko icyo dukora, ushinzwe uburuhukiro yandikira umuyobozi mukuru w’ibitaro,akandika ko hari umurambo ugomba gushyingurwa,kandi udafite ba nyirawo, hanyuma tugatanga amafaranga ya ‘manpower’ (abakozi bafasha muri icyo gikorwa), ayo mafaranga aturuka mu mafaranga yo gukoresha asanzwe y’ibitaro, icyakora hari ubufasha (support) Akarere kajya gatanga,kakabuha ibitaro,ariko hari ibintu byinshi baba bakubiye hamwe, ntabwo ari ukuvuga ngo ni ayo gushyingura imirambo nk’iyo yabuze ba nyirayo gusa,ahubwo haba hari n’ibindi bibazo nk’abaza kwivuza nyuma bakabura ubwishyu,n’ibindi. Hari ubufasha batanga nubwo bidahura neza na serivisi tuba twatanze”.

“ Abajya gushyingura, tureba abantu badufasha yaba abasanzwe bakora isuku ku bitaro (cleaners), cyangwa se abo dusanga ku irimbi,hanyuma tugakoresha ibikoresho byacu, ibisashi byagenewe gushyirwamo imirambo(body bags)”.

Iyo bagiye gushyingura umurambo nk’uko, byakozwe n’ibitaro, ngo ntabwo habaho bya bindi byo kuvuga ijambo nk’uhagarariye umuryango, Dr Sebajuri yavuze ko ibyo ntabibaho.

Yagize ati,” Iyo mihango ntayibaho, ni ukugenda gushyingura bisanzwe,hari itsinda ry’abantu bava ku bitaro bakagenda bagashyingura bisanzwe.Na bya bindi byo gukaraba iyo abantu bavuye gushyingura, ntabyo. Nonese byabaho bite kandi n’abantu bo mu muryango we batabonetse?ntabyo dukora ibyo gukaraba, kuko tuba turimo kumushyingura ku mafaranga yacu ubwacu. Ntabwo bikorwa.Amafaranga aba ahari yemera ibyo byo gucukura imva n’ibijyana nabyo, urumva ko ibyo bindi ntabwo ibijyamo”.

Ibijya bivugwa ko iyo hagize umuryango uboneka nyuma y’uko umuntu wabo yashyinguwe na Leta cyangwa se yashyuwe n’ibitaro, ngo uwo muryango usabwa kwishyura ikiguzi cy’ibyakozwe, Dr Sebajuri yavuze ko ibyo batajya babikora ngo bashyuze abantu nyuma y’uko bashyinguye uwabo.

Yagize ati, “ Iyo hagize umuryango uboneka nyuma, tubereka aho twashyinguye, hanyuma bakabikora uko babishaka, yaba kumwimura aho, bakajya kumushyingura ahandi,twebwe turamubereka kuko ni uburenganzira bwabo. Umutaliyani Andrea Kimi Antonelli ukinira Mercedes, yanditse amateka muri shampiyona ya Formula 1 nyuma yo kwegukana shampiyona ya 2026, ahita yandika amateka yo kuba umukinnyi muto uyegukanye ndetse aba Umunyataliyani wa mbere uyitwaye kuva Alberto Ascari abikoze mu 1953 bityo asubiza igihugu cye mu mateka y’iri rushanwa rikomeye ku Isi nyuma y’imyaka 73. Uyu musore utwara imodoka ya Mercedes w’imyaka 20 n’iminsi 68, yegukanye iki gikombe nyuma yo gusoza isiganwa rya Grand Prix ya Mexico City ari ku mwanya wa gatatu, ku Cyumweru tariki ya 1 Ugushyingo 2026.

Ibyo byamuhesheje amanota agera kuri 380 atari gutuma bagenzi be bari bahangaye bayakuramo mu gihe hasigaye amasiganwa ane ngo umwaka wa Formula 1 urangire.

Umuholandi Max Verstappen ukinira Red Bull niwe wegukanye isiganwa rya Grand Prix ya Mexico City akaba afite amanota 261 ku mwanya wa Kabiri ku rutonde rusange agakurikirwa na Lewis Hamilton ufite amanota 259.

Verstappen yasoje isiganwa ari imbere ya Hamilton wa Ferrari, wamukurikiye ku mwanya wa kabiri, mu gihe Antonelli yegukanye umwanya wa gatatu ariko wahise umuhesha igikombe cya shampiyona asigaje amasiganwa ane gusa.

Ku myaka 20 n’iminsi 68, Antonelli yahise aba umukinnyi usiganwa muri uyu mukino w'utumodoka duto ukiri muto wegukanye Shampiyona ya Formula 1 mu mateka. Yakuyeho agahigo kari gafitwe na Sebastian Vettel, wagitwaye mu 2010 afite imyaka 23.

Kugeza ubu, Abataliyani batatu ni bo bamaze kwegukana Shampiyona ya Formula 1, aribo Giuseppe Farina mu 1950, Alberto Ascari mu 1952 na 1953, na Kimi Antonelli mu 2026.

Kwegukana iki gikombe kwa Antonelli ni intambwe ikomeye ku Butaliyani, bwari bumaze imyaka 73 butagira umushoferi ubuhagarariye wegukana iri rushanwa rikomeye ku rwego rw’isi.

Ambasaderi w'u Rwanda muri Ghana, Rosemary Mbabazi yasabye Abanyarwanda baba mu mahanga kurangwa n’imyitwarire myiza, guhesha ishema igihugu cyabo no gukoresha amahirwe bafite mu guteza imbere u Rwanda n’imibanire yarwo n’ibindi bihugu.

Yabitangaje mu nama ya mbere ya Unity and Resilience Forum, yabereye i Abidjan muri Côte d’Ivoire, yari ifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti: “Ubumwe n’Ubudaheranwa: Ni amahitamo yacu.”

Iyi nama yahuje Abanyarwanda baba mu mahanga baturutse mu bihugu bitandatu, abafatanyabikorwa baturutse mu Rwanda n’inshuti z’u Rwanda. Yabaye kandi umwanya wo kungurana ibitekerezo ku ruhare Abanyarwanda baba mu mahanga bashobora kugira mu iterambere ry’igihugu.

Mu butumwa yahaye abitabiriye iyi nama, Ambasaderi Mbabazi yabibukije ko aho batuye n’aho bakorera hose bahagarariye u Rwanda. Yagize ati: “Aho mujya hose, muba muri ba ambasaderi b’u Rwanda.”

Yongeyeho ko abantu barenga 200 bitabiriye iyi nama bashobora kugira uruhare rukomeye mu iterambere ry’igihugu igihe ibitekerezo byabo byashyirwa mu bikorwa.

Yasabye Abanyarwanda baba mu mahanga guhuza amahirwe n’iterambere ry’u Rwanda

Ambasaderi Mbabazi yavuze ko u Rwanda n’ibihugu bitandatu byahagarariwe muri iyi nama bifitanye umubano mwiza, ushingiye ku bufatanye n’amasezerano atandukanye, ndetse n’imikoranire y’abakuru b’ibihugu.

Yasabye Abanyarwanda baba muri Côte d’Ivoire by'umwihariko kugira uruhare mu gufasha kurushaho gushimangira uwo mubano, bakoresheje amahirwe babona mu Gihugu batuyemo.

Yagize ati: “Mufite amahirwe. Mujye muyagarura mu Rwanda. Twifuza abafatanyabikorwa benshi hano. Twifuza ko ikoranabuhanga n’ubumenyi byimuka.”

Yabasabye kuba ikiraro gihuza u Rwanda na Côte d’Ivoire, ku buryo habaho imikoranire irushijeho gukomera mu bucuruzi, ishoramari, ikoranabuhanga no gusangira ubumenyi.

Yabasabye kwamamaza ibikorerwa mu Rwanda

Ambasaderi Mbabazi yanashimangiye uruhare rw’abikorera mu iterambere ry’igihugu, asaba Abanyarwanda baba mu mahanga gushyigikira ubucuruzi bw’Abanyarwanda bagura ibikorerwa mu gihugu kandi bakabimenyekanisha mu mahanga.

Yagize ati: “Mugure ibikorerwa mu Rwanda kandi murwamamaze.”

Yavuze ko Abanyarwanda baba mu mahanga ari abafatanyabikorwa b’ingenzi mu rugendo rw’iterambere ry’igihugu, ashimangira ko gutegura ejo hazaza hagomba no kuzirikana inyungu z’urubyiruko n’ibiragano bizaza, nk’uko biteganywa muri gahunda y’Igihugu y’Icyerekezo 2050.

Iyi nama yatangijwe n’ibiganiro byahuje inzobere n’abafatanyabikorwa, hanatangwa ibisobanuro ku mahirwe y’ishoramari binyuze mu Kigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Iterambere (RDB), ndetse hanamurikwa ibicuruzwa bikorerwa mu Rwanda.

Ambasaderi Mbabazi yavuze ko iyi nama ari intangiriro y’ibikorwa bigamije guhindura ibitekerezo n’ibiganiro amahirwe afatika, ashimangira ko hari byinshi byitezwe mu bikorwa bizakurikiraho.
